questions.question: The average age of 24 students in a class is 15.5 years. The age of their teacher is 28 years more than the average of all twenty-five. What is the age of the teacher in years?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

The average age of 24 students in a class is 15.5 years. The age of their teacher is 28 years more than the average of all twenty-five.

**Formula Used**:

average = sum of observation/number of observation

**Calculation**:

Average age of 24 students in the class = 15.5 years

⇒ Total age of 24 students = 24 × 15.5 = 372 years

Let age of teacher = x years and average age of all 25 = (372 + x)/(25)

⇒ x = 28 + (372 + x)/(25)

⇒ 25x - x = 700 + 372

⇒ x = (1072)/(24) = (134)/(3)

Thus, age of teacher = 44(2)/(3) years

questions.question:
What value would come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

 (6)/(7) times 392 + 25 \% { of } 260 = 16 \% { of } 550 + ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 (6)/(7) times 392 + 25 \% { of } 260 = 16 \% { of } 550 + ? 

**Formula used:**

Percentage Formula: {Percentage} = frac{{Part}}{{Whole}} times 100 

**Calculation:**

 (6)/(7) times 392 = 336 

 25 \% { of } 260 = (25)/(100) times 260 = 65 

 16 \% { of } 550 = (16)/(100) times 550 = 88 

⇒ 336 + 65 = 88 + ? 

⇒ 401 = 88 + ? 

⇒ ? = 401 - 88 

⇒ ? = 313 

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: Jay started a business investing Rs. 12,000. After four months, Ajay joined him with a capital of Rs. 16,000. At the end of the year, they made a profit of Rs. 5,100. What should Ajay's share be in the venture?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Investment of Jay = Rs. 12

Investment of Ajay = Rs. 16000

Total Annual Profit = Rs. 5100

Time period of investment of Jay = 12 months

Time period of investment o Ajay = 8 months

**Concept Used:**

Profit Ratio = (Investment × Time Period) 

**Calculation:**

Investment × Time Period of Jay = 12000 × 12

Investment × Time Period of Ajay = 16000 × 8

⇒ Profit ratio of Jay : Ajay = 12000 × 12 : 16000 × 8 = 9 : 8

Now, Share of Ajay = 5100 × (8)/(17) = 2400

∴ Share of Ajay = Rs. 2400.

questions.question:
In the adjoining figure line l is parallel to line m. What is the value of (x + 2y) ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905c2a270ecc9e29bc4cc0942201541f2d5e6ffded406685ccf504d4f877d95c.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify that **line l** and **line m** are **parallel**, making **x** and **y** co-interior angles.

The sum of **co-interior angles** is always **180°**, so **x + y = 180°**.

The expression **(x + 2y)** can be rewritten as **(x + y) + y**.

From the geometric figure, the obtuse angle **y** is **135°**, which means **x = 45°**.

⇒ **(x + 2y) = 180° + 135° = 315°**.

**∴ The correct answer is 315°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Line **l || m**.

⇒ Angle **x** and angle **y** are **interior angles** on the same side of the **transversal**.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Sum of **co-interior angles** = **180°**.

⇒ **Linear Pair** property: Sum of angles on a straight line = **180°**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb6df9dee73600e7e976b5de82ac218cd1bc9d20a3a619d5ebb5302638e9bf98.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Since **l || m**, the **co-interior angles** **x** and **y** satisfy the condition: **x + y = 180°**.

⇒ From the given figure, the value of the **obtuse angle** **y** is observed to be **135°**.

⇒ To find **x**: **x = 180° − 135° = 45°**.

⇒ Now, calculate the required value: **(x + 2y)**.

⇒ **(x + 2y) = 45° + 2(135°)**.

⇒ **(x + 2y) = 45° + 270°**.

⇒ **(x + 2y) = 315°**.

**∴ The correct answer is 315°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Corresponding Angles

When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, the angles in matching corners are equal.

Alternate Interior Angles

Angles between parallel lines on opposite sides of a transversal are equal (Z-pattern).

Consecutive Interior Angles

Also known as co-interior angles, these are located between the parallel lines on the same side and sum to 180°.</p

questions.question: The HCF of any two even perfect square will be at least
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two even perfect squares.

**Concept used:**

The square of even is always even and odd is always odd.

The square of two consecutive even numbers is always a consecutive even perfect square.

**Calculation:**

Let's take two consecutive even numbers i.e, 2x and 2x + 2.

So, two even consecutive perfect square is (2x)² and (2x + 2)² i.e., 4x² and 4(x + 1)²

Now, factor of both numbers

4x² and 4(x+1)². Therefore, the only common factor we get here is one and only 4, which turns out to be HCF itself.

**Thus, The HCF of two even consecutive perfect squares will be at least 4.**

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1).**

questions.question: If ( x + (2)/(x) ) = 7, then what is the value of ( 2x² + (8)/(x²) ) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ (x + 2/x) = 7

**Formula:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒(x + 2/x) = 7

Squaring on both sides of the equation, we get

⇒(x + 2/x)2 = 7²

Using the formula: (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

⇒ x2 + 4/x2 + 2 × x × 2/x = 49

⇒x² + 4/x² + 4 = 49

⇒ x² + 4/x² = 49 - 4

⇒ x2 + 4/x2 = 45 

Multiplying by 2 on both sides of the equation, we get

⇒ 2 × (x2 + 4/x²) = 45 × 2

⇒ 2x² + 8/x² = 90

**∴ The value of (2x² + 8/x²) is 90.**

questions.question: Sanjay scored 75 out of 150 marks in his mid-term exam and 105 out of 150 in his annual exam. The percentage increase in his marks is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **mid-term marks** to **annual exam marks** = 75 : 105 = 5 : 7

Increase in units = 7 − 5 = 2 units

**Percentage increase** = (Increase ÷ Initial units) × 100

⇒ (2 ÷ 5) × 100 = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Score in **mid-term exam** = 75

Score in **annual exam** = 105

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ff3791c7f73d26dc69d37d4210ab4c111e21e44b9f78aae2c4ad98912f1a6f6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Actual increase in **marks** = 105 − 75 = 30

⇒ Percentage increase = (30 ÷ 75) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = (2 ÷ 5) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 2 × 20%

⇒ Percentage increase = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

It is the **relative change** between an old value and a new value, expressed as a percentage of the **original value**.

Base Value Rule

In any **percentage increase** or **decrease** calculation, the denominator is always the **initial (starting) value**.

Common Fractions

Knowing that 1/5 = 20%, 2/5 = 40%, 3/5 = 60%, and 4/5 = 80% helps in **fast calculation** for exams.</p

questions.question: Find the least number which when divided by 11,12,13,14 and 15 leaves the remainder 2 in each case.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **least number** is found using **LCM(11, 12, 13, 14, 15) + Remainder**.

Checking divisibility of (Option − 2) by 11 and 15.

60062 − 2 = 60060, which is divisible by both 11 and 15.

**∴ The correct answer is 60062.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisors are 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15. The constant **remainder** is 2.

**Formula Used:** Required Number = LCM(Divisors) + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88e63e3c1329df82862fb3e346ac3a6cd804c519e18ed64ddda7149a9a69792b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of divisors:

⇒ 11 = 11¹

⇒ 12 = 2² × 3¹

⇒ 13 = 13¹

⇒ 14 = 2¹ × 7¹

⇒ 15 = 3¹ × 5¹

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3¹ × 5¹ × 7¹ × 11¹ × 13¹

⇒ LCM = 4 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 11 × 13 = 60060

⇒ Required Number = 60060 + 2 = 60062

**∴ The correct answer is 60062.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Method for Remainders

When a number leaves the same remainder 'r' for different divisors, the number is of the form [LCM(divisors) × k] + r.

HCF for Remainders

To find the **greatest number** that divides x, y, and z leaving remainders a, b, and c, calculate HCF((x−a), (y−b), (z−c)).

Common Difference Case

If the difference between divisor and remainder is constant (d = divisor − remainder), the least number is LCM(divisors) − d.</p
